project: Large-Scale Telecommunication Data Processing and Performance Monitoring Using MapReduce

performance_benchmarks.throughput_efficiency: Instantaneous (< 50ms) user navigation between all 7 sections

bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.bottleneck: Streamlit filesystem watchdog scanning large workspace (640MB+ in data/raw and data/processed)
bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.resolution: Configured '--server.fileWatcherType=none' and '--server.runOnSave=false' in launcher, eliminating directory recursion and file lock contention.

bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.bottleneck: Coarse-grained monolithic data loader reading all 4 report JSON files simultaneously
bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.resolution: Implemented granular '@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)' loaders for analytics, anomalies, mapreduce, benchmark, and individual DataFrames.

bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.bottleneck: Repeated DataFrame allocation and schema conversions on every user rerun
bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.resolution: Pre-parsed and cached Arrow DataFrames directly from precomputed TSV/CSV and JSON streams in memory.

bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.bottleneck: Eager execution of all section logic during page initialization
bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.resolution: Architected lazy-dispatch section router ('section_dispatch[section]()') evaluating only the active selected view.

bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.bottleneck: Lack of dynamic client-side filtering without re-running heavy backend operations
bottlenecks_identified_and_resolved.resolution: Added instant in-memory sliders and dropdowns for Top N cells, Country code search, Diurnal morning/afternoon/night temporal slices, and Anomaly severity filters.
